# The Fairy type (optional)

Birch's first question at the start of the game turns the Fairy type on or off. With it on, the game uses Gen 6's type chart and these changes. With it off, everything is as in Black 2.

## Pokémon that gain the Fairy type

| Clefable | Fairy |
| Jigglypuff | Normal / Fairy |
| Wigglytuff | Normal / Fairy |

## Moves that become Fairy-type

- Sweet Kiss
- Charm
- Moonlight
